item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Information #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 10:00 PM, 04 November 2026

Thunderstorm is LESS LIKELY to develop over Greater Metro Manila Area(Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna and Cavite) within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 3:05 AM, 04 November 2026(Wednesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Quezon (Perez, Alabat, Quezon, Atimonan, Plaridel, Padre Burgos, Lucena, Tayabas, Candelaria, Sariaya, Lucban, Pagbilao, Mauban, Polillo, Jomalig, Patnanungan, Burdeos, Panukulan, Calauag, Gumaca, Sampaloc, Real, Dolores, Agdangan, and Unisan) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
